english.title: Firearms dealer fail to surrender certificate of registration under section 40 of the Firearms Act 1968
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a firearms dealer who was given notice in writing on **(..SPECIFY THE DATE..) by the chief officer of police, namely **(..SPECIFY NAME..), that your name had been removed from the register of dealer's names, you failed when required, to surrender your certificate of registration and
(A)_[the register of transactions kept by you under section 40 of the Firearms Act 1968]_
(B)_[a copy of the information comprised in the register of transactions under section 40 of the Firearms Act 1968 in a visible and legible form]_

within twenty-one days from the date of the notice
english.legislation: Contrary to section 38(8) of and Schedule 6 to the Firearms Act 1968.
